_doc: Agent Mesh switches (Zulu Assistant example; copy to overlay/config/mesh.json). autoRename: the board types `/rename <title-slug>` into idle Claude panes whose session name drifted from their workspace title. chrome: keep cmux workspace colors/descriptions + the task/ctx pills in line with the directory and ledger (hand-set values always win). Groups are CLI-only (mesh-cli.mjs sync-groups). domains: the kinds of work your agents own, in sidebar order ({id, label, color, icon}; codex panes share one violet). repoDomains: repo path (~ or glob) → domain; scripts/cmux-chrome-config.mjs tints matching workspace groups.
